Calls work with Element X, media can go to an S3 bucket, and the image carries this repo's version.

## ✨ Added

- **Element Call for Element X.** Set `ELEMENT_CALL_LIVEKIT_SERVICE_URL` to your LiveKit JWT service and Synapse advertises the MatrixRTC transport, allows delayed events and gets the rate limits Element Call needs. Element Web uses Element Call too. LiveKit and the JWT service run as two separate containers, see the [setup guide](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix/blob/main/docs/setup.md#element-call).
- **Optional S3 media storage.** `S3_MEDIA_ENABLED` copies every new upload to an S3-compatible bucket such as SeaweedFS or Garage, and the local volume stays as a cache. `S3_MEDIA_ENDPOINT` has no default, and the container refuses to start without it rather than talk to AWS.
- **`TURN_EXTERNAL_IP`** sets coturn's `external-ip`. Behind NAT, coturn otherwise offers its private address and calls between networks fail.
- **`ELEMENT_EXTRA_FEATURES`** merges a JSON object into Element Web's labs flags, for example `{"feature_html_topic": true}`. Invalid JSON is dropped with a warning. Requested in [#27](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix/issues/27).
- **`ELEMENT_EXTRA_CONFIG`** merges a JSON object into Element Web's `config.json`, for anything the template has no field for.
- **`/data/homeserver-custom.yaml`** is read after the generated config, so settings the container rewrites on every start, such as `max_upload_size`, can be changed. Invalid YAML stops the container with an error.

## 🎨 Design

- **A new knight banner with the title on one line.** Banner, title and READY status form one block, and it is the last thing the container prints on boot.
- **A shorter README with new screenshots** of Element Web and Ketesa. The full guides moved to `docs/setup.md`.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Synapse [v1.162.0](https://github.com/element-hq/synapse/releases/tag/v1.162.0), Element Web [v1.12.30](https://github.com/element-hq/element-web/releases/tag/v1.12.30), Ketesa [v1.5.1](https://github.com/etkecc/ketesa/releases/tag/v1.5.1) and Matrix Authentication Service [1.26.0](https://github.com/element-hq/matrix-authentication-service/releases/tag/v1.26.0).**
- **Image tags follow this repo's version.** A release is published as `X.Y.Z`, `X.Y`, `X` and `latest`, and `latest` moves only with a release. The Synapse version is in the label `io.github.junkerderprovinz.matrix.synapse-version`. Synapse-version tags are no longer published, so a template pinned to one should switch to `latest`.
- A merge to main builds `edge`, and only when the image changes. New Synapse releases come through Renovate and ship with the next release.
- **Element Web follows the browser language** and shows **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page. To keep German and hide the link, set `ELEMENT_EXTRA_CONFIG` to `{"setting_defaults": {"language": "de_DE", "UIFeature.passwordReset": false}}`.
- The Unraid template has fields for TURN External IP, Element Call and the two Element Web JSON settings, the last three under **Show more settings**.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **gosu comes from the static upstream build.** Debian's package was built with Go 1.24.4 and carried two reachable standard library vulnerabilities, GO-2026-4602 and GO-2025-3956.
- A missing or rotated Docker Hub token skips the mirror instead of failing the GHCR push as well.

Element Call, TURN External IP and the two Element Web settings started as work by [@ezz-91](https://github.com/ezz-91) in their fork. Thank you!
